title: Goosebumps-ish : Escape the House!
author: snail
description:
A fun goosebumps-inspired interactive adventure for kids and adults who wish they were kids.
This adventure sees you wake up in a sinister (haunted? Possibly...) house in the middle of nowhere, with nothing to do but explore. What you'll find could be hilarious, sickening, terrifying...or maybe even all three and more!
READER BEWARE, YOURE (hopefully, but maybe not, because you arent 10 anymore) IN FOR A SCARE!! :-)
